newsitem.title: UK: Chiroscience in research alliance with Alcon.
newsitem.headline: Chiroscience in research alliance with Alcon.

text.p: British pharmaceuticals company Chiroscience Group Plc said on Monday it had agreed a research alliance with U.S. opthalmic specialist Alcon Laboratories Inc, a unit of Swiss group Nestle S.A..
Chiroscience said the agreement aimed to combine its chemistry skills with Alcon's high throughput screening and applied biology expertise to develop small molecule drugs.
Alcon will test Chiroscience's directed libraries of compounds, including enzyme inhibitors, through a range of high intensity biological assays.

Alcon will retain the rights to any products for ophthalmic and optic applications and Chiroscience will have the rights to all other uses of drug candidates discovered during the alliance, the British company said in a statement.
Both companies will have the right to receive royalties from drugs generated by the alliance.
